notes.title: Pre-order Wuppo: Breft Festival (Forever) now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Hello! Long time no see. We’ve been very busy working on our upcoming game Wuppo: Breft Festival (Forever)! And we need your help in order to complete it. 
Please check out the brand new video, details & Kickstarter page here: Wuppo: Breft Festival (Forever) on Kickstarter. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38312615/cda6e7ff16e8aa876e3da5cd47d2402fe274c899.gif

You can also pre-order the game on Kickstarter. And there are many more rewards for pledging on Kickstarter!

[previewyoutube=2o5DA33Mf7s;full][/previewyoutube]

Cheers!
Lars & Thomas
